name: typography
title: Typography
description: The type scale and a Prose wrapper for the notebook: script headings with a hand-drawn rule, body text in the hand at 17 px on a 1.7 line, blue felt links, marker bullets, mono code chips. Prose styles markup you did not write (markdown, CMS html, MDX).

a11y: Real elements with their real semantics: h1 to h4, p, ul/ol, blockquote, code. Nothing here changes the outline or the reading order.

Body text is the hand at 17 px in ink on paper (14:1); muted text is the muted-foreground token (4.5:1 or better on paper and on the desk); links are blue felt (7:1) and bold with a thick underline, never colour alone.
The hand-drawn heading rule is a baked alpha mask painted by ::after; browsers without mask support keep a plain pencil border. Windows high contrast paints the rule with system text colour.
Line length is capped at 64 characters in Prose; long words wrap and code blocks scroll sideways (a table wider than the column needs a scrolling wrapper of its own).
